entities.name: RecO (Xylella fastidiosa)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Xylella fastidiosa RecO references; 243 aa, calculated mass 27.44 kDa and pI 9.20.
Annotated as participating in DNA repair and RecF-pathway recombination; associated GO terms include DNA recombination, double-strand break repair, and bacterial nucleoid.
No catalytic reaction was retrieved; this alone does not establish absence of enzymatic activity.
